intro: Farren's Proof is an Alliance courier mission within the harbor town of Southshore. Acting on behalf of Marshal Redpath, an adventurer delivers orders directing Lieutenant Farren Orinelle to focus his military attention on the naga encroaching upon the Eastern Strand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Please inform Lieutenant Orinelle that I would like him to refocus his efforts on the naga infesting the Eastern Strand.
When he has results, tell him to report to me in person.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Redpath must have just received the same information as me... Ha! He'll not receive a promotion from my toil.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
